# Compute normalized weights (future offset t starting at 1)
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(1, future_horizon + 1)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        norm_weights = raw_weights
    else:
        norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
    L_plus = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
